instruction.text: Right now you are in front of the round table, now turn left, and go near the fire place, now turn right, and go near the glass window, now again turn right, and go straight, now you will find table in front of you, now go near the table, and slightly turn left, there you will find an open door, now enter into the bedroom, and turn right, now go straight, there you will find two open doors, now on the left side, you will find bath tub, now keep moving forward, on the right side, you will find open door, now enter into the door, and stand in front of the commode, that will be your final destination.
